_readme: Sample corrections, paired with data/sample.csv. The real pair —
data/source.csv and data/overrides.json — is gitignored; the build falls
back to these so a fresh clone runs with no setup.
See UPDATING.md for what each section is for.

notes.detail: Every band and venue here is invented, so the repo runs and the layout can be exercised without publishing a real show history. Point data/source.csv at your own export to replace it.
